summary.text: Mark Koran is a Republican state senator from Minnesota who represents District 28 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026 against Democrat Max Glenna.
He is a business executive who has served in the Minnesota State Senate since 2017.

paragraphs.text: Koran was born in St. Paul, Minnesota.
His Ballotpedia profile lists his Senate tenure as beginning in 2017 and his current term as beginning on January 3, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Local Government Committee, the Elections Committee, where he was ranking minority member, and the Health and Human Services Finance and Policy Committee.
